note: Zoom (new, S03 split) on the sink corner of the B61 ground-floor workshop: sage-green plaster with patches of bare brick, dark oak posts, a band of blue-and-white tiles, slate floor. LANDMARK: the big stone sink with its tall brass tap and the plate shelf above it. The strip's Back button returns to the workshop. Adjectives have no gender (divider null).

items.scene: doll in Polish folk costume dancing on the music box beside a neighing toy polo pony
old man turning a tangled diagram round: he cannot see a thing
little kid in red wellies leaping into the puddle under the sink
cat, dog and rabbit doing the household dusting on the plate shelf
swan admiring its immaculate feathers in the mirror
